comparison_protocol: Same saved rows, groups, duplicate-disjoint masks, canonical NLL, dataset CSV hashes, 512-row scoring chunks, and 500 claim bootstraps; exact all500 reference bootstrap parity plus first5 seeded replay verified
strict_bootstrap_protocol: 500 new paired normalized-claim group draws on each strict subset; seed=441+int(SHA256("strict:"+dataset_name)[:8],16); groups made contiguous after exclusion; fold each dataset draw before fixed-dataset macro; whole-draw finite filtering

fit_report.interpretation: Exploratory; source-validation-informed feature pool; outer validation is diagnostic

limitations: Exploratory head designed after benchmark results had been viewed
All source programs selected on prior train/validation labels; outer and inner-CV estimates do not nest feature discovery
Claim bootstrap conditions on frozen selected programs, coefficients and datasets; no search-seed uncertainty or multiplicity correction
Duplicate-disjoint removes normalized-claim training overlap only; not entity/relation disjoint
Numerical comparison to reported Claude73.4 is unmatched supervision/search/test selection, not SOTA evidence
